title: selaginella argentea
intro: Selaginella argentea, commonly known as Silver Spikemoss, is a species of evergreen perennial plant in the Selaginellaceae family, known for its unique silver-green foliage. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of Selaginella argentea include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
